descriptionChirho: To beget or sire offspring, with the father as the active agent, used both of physical lineage (genealogies) and of God's unique relationship to the Son.
To be born or brought into existence (passive), whether physical birth, spiritual rebirth ('born of God/Spirit'), or conception, with the one born as the grammatical subject.
To give birth to a child, with the mother as the active agent who bears or brings forth offspring.
